name: BEN JOHN VILLABESA
title: Full-Stack Software Engineer // Building the Future

bio: Full-stack software engineer with 5+ years of experience building end-to-end systems — from warehouse management and supply chain platforms to AI-powered content orchestration and cybersecurity intelligence tools.

Currently building AI-integrated platforms at PrimeDesk Solutions and Cecuri, working with self-hosted LLM inference (vLLM, Ollama), agentic AI pipelines (LangChain/LangGraph), and multi-GPU task orchestration.
I enjoy owning the full stack — designing backend APIs, building responsive frontends, developing mobile apps, and wiring up the infrastructure to make it all run reliably in production.

projects.title: Arcanova
projects.description: Self-hosted, team collaboration and project management platform featuring an AES-256-GCM encrypted secrets vault, lightweight feature planning with drag-and-drop Kanban boards, issue tracking with multiple views (Kanban/list/calendar), Tiptap rich text documentation, Stripe/PayMongo (GCash) subscription billing, OAuth authentication (GitHub/Google) via Auth.js v5 with JWT sessions, threaded comments with @mentions, PostgreSQL trigram fuzzy search, comprehensive audit logging, and an admin dashboard — all built as a full-stack Next.js 15 App Router application with Prisma ORM and Dockerized deployment with MinIO S3-compatible object storage.
longDescription: Built a production-ready team collaboration platform centered around secure project management — projects support multi-role access (Owner/Editor/Viewer) with magic-link invitations, and each project contains features, issues, tasks, notes, and an encrypted secrets vault. The secrets vault uses AES-256-GCM encryption with PBKDF2 key derivation (100k iterations, SHA-512), per-secret random IVs, and supports environment scoping (Dev/Staging/Prod/All) with granular access levels (Team/Personal/Specific). Secrets are click-to-reveal with 10-second auto-hide, rate-limited to 30 reveals per minute, and support bulk .env import/export. Secret values are never logged anywhere in the system. The feature planning system follows a 5-status workflow (Idea → Planned → In Progress → Shipped → Dropped) with drag-and-drop Kanban boards using @dnd-kit and fractional indexing for stable ordering, while issues support Kanban, list, and calendar views with inline editing and many-to-many assignees.

The subscription system supports two tiers — Initiate (Free: 3 projects, 10 features, 20 secrets, 15 notes, 2 collaborators per project) and Archmage (Pro: unlimited everything + roadmap view + unlimited activity retention) — with Stripe integration for global card payments and PayMongo for GCash/QR targeting Philippine users. Webhook processing uses signature verification and idempotent event tracking via a WebhookEvent model. The collaboration layer includes threaded comments with @mention autocomplete and notification generation, in-app notifications for invites, role changes, and mentions, plus a comprehensive activity audit log tracking every mutation with before/after diffs. Full-text search leverages PostgreSQL pg_trgm trigram similarity across projects, features, issues, notes, and secret keys via a Cmd+K command palette with fuzzy matching and RBAC-scoped results.

Authentication uses Auth.js (NextAuth) v5 in JWT mode with GitHub and Google OAuth providers, 30-day session maxAge with 24-hour sliding window refresh, and no passwords stored. The Next.js 15 frontend features a dark arcane aesthetic with angular chamfered corners, mouse-tracking glow borders, and a constellation particle background. The UI includes a Tiptap rich text editor for documentation with code blocks, tables, and task lists, Recharts analytics, TanStack React Table for data display, react-day-picker for calendar views, and cmdk for the command palette. The admin dashboard provides user management with tier upgrades/downgrades, admin promotion, GDPR-style deletion, support ticket responses, and bug bounty tracking with severity levels. The Dockerized deployment stack (PostgreSQL, MinIO, Next.js app, plus optional migration service and MinIO init) includes health checks, persistent volumes, and is designed for deployment behind an external Nginx reverse proxy with SSL termination.

projects.title: StreamFree
projects.description: Self-hosted, open-access video streaming platform targeting Philippine audiences featuring adaptive bitrate HLS streaming with FFmpeg transcoding (360p–1080p), donation-based monetization via Stripe/PayPal/PayMongo (GCash), JWT authentication with Google OAuth, threaded comments with admin moderation, trending algorithm and featured carousel, watch history with resume playback, full-text search with PostgreSQL trigram similarity, and a comprehensive admin analytics dashboard — all managed through a responsive Next.js frontend with Zustand state management and Dockerized deployment with SeaweedFS S3-compatible object storage.
longDescription: Built a production self-hosted video streaming platform designed for open access — anyone can browse and watch public videos without an account, while registered users gain enhanced features like watchlists, personalized watch history with resume playback, threaded comments, reactions, and donation support. The admin-curated content model means only administrators upload videos, which are automatically transcoded via FFmpeg Celery workers into multi-quality HLS streams (360p/480p/720p/1080p) with adaptive bitrate switching. Raw uploads support files up to 10GB via presigned SeaweedFS URLs, and the transcoding pipeline follows a pending_upload → processing → ready lifecycle with automatic thumbnail generation. The HLS.js-based video player provides full controls including seek, volume, fullscreen, picture-in-picture, playback speed (0.5x–2x), manual quality selection, and keyboard shortcuts, with 30-day immutable segment caching and 5-minute playlist caching.

The donation system supports three payment providers — Stripe for global card payments, PayPal for international accessibility, and PayMongo for GCash integration targeting Philippine users — with dual currency support (PHP and USD), minimum amounts (₱50.00 PHP / $1.00 USD), webhook-verified processing with idempotent event tracking via ProcessedWebhookEvent, and immutable completed donation records. The engagement layer includes like/dislike reactions (one per user per video), threaded comments with nested replies and admin approval workflow, view count tracking with Redis-based rate limiting (one count per IP per video per 24 hours), and a trending algorithm that weighs views and likes against recency using the formula (view_count×1.0 + like_count×2.0) / (hours_since+2)^1.5. Full-text search leverages PostgreSQL trigram similarity across titles, descriptions, and tags with auto-suggest debounced dropdown and filtering by category, upload date, duration, and popularity.

Authentication uses django-allauth in headless JWT mode with email/password registration, email verification, Google OAuth, password reset, 15-minute access tokens with 7-day refresh token rotation stored in HTTP-only cookies, and Argon2 password hashing. The Next.js 15 frontend features a responsive Tailwind CSS design with featured carousel (cross-fade animations), trending grid, category browsing, collapsible sidebar navigation, dynamic form line items with real-time calculations, paginated data tables with status badges, and browser print-to-PDF reporting. The admin dashboard provides analytics with Recharts (LineChart/BarChart), video management with upload monitoring, user management with ban/delete (GDPR-style removal), comment moderation queue with bulk actions, and donation reports with CSV/Excel export. The eight-service Docker Compose stack (PostgreSQL, Redis, SeaweedFS, SeaweedFS-init, Django/Gunicorn, Celery Worker, Celery Beat, Next.js) includes health checks, resource limits (Celery worker: 2 CPU/4GB), persistent volumes, and is designed for deployment behind an external Nginx reverse proxy with SSL termination.

projects.title: AI-Powered Penetration Testing Platform
projects.description: Full-stack AI-enhanced penetration testing reconnaissance platform that automates security scanning through containerized Kali Linux environments, chains 10+ offensive security tools via intelligent AI orchestration (Ollama LLM), enriches findings with severity assessment and remediation guidance, correlates discoveries across scan modules, and delivers real-time monitoring through a WebSocket-powered Next.js dashboard with multi-format report generation.
longDescription: Built a production AI-powered reconnaissance platform that automates penetration testing workflows end-to-end. The system runs three scan modules — Recon (subfinder, httpx, dig, whois, waybackurls), Port Scan (naabu, nmap), and Web Scan (nuclei, nikto, ffuf) — inside ephemeral Kali Linux Docker containers with strict resource limits (512 MB memory, 50% CPU cap) and network isolation. An AI orchestration engine powered by Ollama dynamically chains modules based on discovered findings: recon runs first, then the LLM evaluates preconditions (live hosts required for port scans, open ports or live hosts for web scans) and emits structured JSON decisions (run/skip/done) with reasoning, up to a configurable max depth of 5 iterations. Each decision is persisted as an OrchestratorDecision audit record and streamed to the frontend via WebSocket.

The analytics and enrichment layer processes every finding through Ollama-powered structured output: assigning severity (critical/high/medium/low/info), applying classification tags (admin-panel, api-endpoint, dev-environment), generating per-finding remediation steps, and producing scan-level summaries with top critical findings and prioritized recommendations. Cross-module host correlation groups findings by normalized hostname across recon, port, and web scans via a HostCorrelation model with M2M junction tables. Rule-based deduplication identifies hosts confirmed by multiple tools and marks findings with dedup_group_id and confirmed_by_tools metadata. Incremental diff computation against previous scans flags new/unchanged/modified findings. Project-level executive summaries aggregate risk posture across all completed scans.

The Next.js 15 frontend (React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui) provides a real-time dark-themed dashboard with a ScanPipeline timeline showing live tool execution status, heartbeat elapsed times, and expandable error details. State management combines Zustand stores with TanStack Query for server-state caching and optimistic updates. The backend is FastAPI 0.135 (Python 3.12) with SQLAlchemy 2.0 async ORM on PostgreSQL 16, Celery 5.6 task queue with Redis 7 broker, and Alembic migrations. Report generation supports HTML, Markdown, and PDF (WeasyPrint) via Jinja2 templates with branded cover pages, severity-grouped findings, and AI-generated recommendations. Deployment is a six-service Docker Compose stack (backend, worker, beat, frontend, PostgreSQL, Redis) with two isolated networks (internal-net for services, scan-net for Kali containers), persistent volumes, health checks, and an optional Flower monitoring dashboard.

projects.title: Accounting System
projects.description: Full-stack BIR-compliant multi-company accounting platform for Philippine businesses featuring double-entry bookkeeping with immutable audit trails, automated statutory tax computations (VAT, EWT, TRAIN Law), complete payroll processing with SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG deductions, FIFO/Weighted Average inventory management, bank reconciliation with CSV import and auto-matching, BIR e-filing form generation (2550M, 2550Q, 1601-E, 1601-C), and comprehensive financial reporting — all managed through a responsive Next.js dashboard with multi-tenant company switching, role-based access control, and Dockerized deployment behind Nginx reverse proxy.
longDescription: Built a production multi-company accounting platform fully compliant with Philippine BIR (Bureau of Internal Revenue) and PFRS/PAS standards. The shared-database multi-tenancy architecture isolates company data via a CompanyScopedManager that automatically filters all querysets by the active company, injected through middleware from X-Company-ID headers. The double-entry bookkeeping engine enforces balanced journal entries (SUM(debits) == SUM(credits)) with NUMERIC(18,4) precision for tax and foreign exchange calculations, supports a Draft → Posted → Voided lifecycle with immutable posted entries, and links sub-ledger documents (invoices, bills, payroll, inventory) back to the general ledger via generic foreign keys for full drill-down capability. A hierarchical Chart of Accounts supports parent-child relationships with header/detail classification, and fiscal periods can be opened, closed, or locked to prevent unauthorized postings.

The tax compliance layer automates VAT (12%) computation on sales invoices and purchase bills, calculates Expanded Withholding Tax (EWT) based on vendor-configured ATC (Alphanumeric Tax Code) rates, generates BIR forms (2550M monthly VAT, 2550Q quarterly VAT, 1601-E monthly EWT, 1601-C monthly compensation, 1604C/1604E annual alphalists), produces Summary Lists of Sales and Purchases (SLSP) with CSV export in BIR-prescribed format, and tracks CAS (Computerized Accounting System) compliance through immutable audit logs. The payroll module processes batch payroll runs with automatic statutory deduction calculations — SSS contributions from database-driven bracket tables, PhilHealth premium sharing with floor/ceiling caps, Pag-IBIG tiered contributions, and TRAIN Law graduated income tax with base tax and marginal rates — plus government remittance tracking with period-based aggregation and journal entry posting.

The inventory module supports FIFO and Weighted Average costing methods with immutable stock movement records, a full Purchase Order workflow (Draft → Approved → Partially Received → Received → Closed) with goods receiving and quantity tracking, stock adjustments for physical counts/damage/shrinkage with variance calculation, and inter-warehouse transfers. Bank reconciliation imports CSV statements with hash-based deduplication, auto-matches register entries to statement lines by amount/date/description, supports manual matching and bank adjustment creation (service charges, interest income, NSF checks), and calculates adjusted bank vs book balances. The Next.js 16 frontend uses a responsive Tailwind CSS design with a company-switching header, collapsible sidebar navigation, dynamic form line items with real-time total calculations, data tables with pagination and filtering, status badges, and browser print-to-PDF reporting. Security includes JWT authentication with silent token refresh and mutex-locked concurrent 401 handling, role-based access control (Admin, Accountant, Payroll Officer, Inventory Manager, Auditor) with per-module permissions (view/create/edit/post/void), encrypted model fields for sensitive data, parameterized SQL queries, and a seven-service Docker Compose stack (Django/Gunicorn, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Nginx, Celery Worker, Celery Beat) with health checks, resource limits, and Nginx reverse proxy with security headers.

projects.title: SEO Ranking Intelligence
projects.description: Full-stack multi-client SEO rank tracking platform that automates Google SERP monitoring across geographic locations via pluggable search providers (SerpAPI, DataForSEO, SearXNG), detects rank changes with historical trend analysis, discovers new keyword opportunities from related searches, identifies competitor domains and URL cannibalization, and delivers webhook-driven rank alerts — all managed through a real-time React dashboard with PDF/CSV reporting and a dark-themed analytics UI.
longDescription: Built a production multi-client SEO intelligence platform that tracks Google search rankings across keywords and geographic locations end-to-end. The provider-agnostic scan engine supports three interchangeable SERP data sources — SerpAPI, DataForSEO, and self-hosted SearXNG — with runtime switching via an admin endpoint and zero code changes. Each scan processes keywords in concurrent batches of 5, paginates up to 3 SERP pages (30 results) with early termination when the client domain is found, applies exponential backoff retry (3 attempts), and extracts organic rank, URL, snippet, top-3 competitors, local pack position, SERP features (featured snippets, knowledge graph, People Also Ask, image pack), and related searches for keyword discovery. A nightly cron job (2 AM Central) filters clients by configurable scan frequency (daily/weekly/monthly), prevents duplicate jobs, and fires webhooks with rank-alert payloads when keywords drop below per-client thresholds.

The analytics layer computes rank distribution buckets (top 3, page 1, page 2+, not ranked), historical rank deltas with directional indicators, URL cannibalization detection (multiple client URLs ranking for the same keyword), and competitor domain frequency analysis across the entire keyword portfolio. Keyword discovery automatically extracts related searches from SERP data and stores them as suggestions (is_target=0) with a one-click promote workflow to active tracking. Reporting includes streaming CSV export via fast-csv, and client-side multi-page PDF generation (jsPDF + html2canvas) with branded cover pages, summary charts, keyword cards with 7-day sparkline trends, competitor landscape bar charts, and cannibalization tables. Bulk keyword management supports CSV import with validation, per-keyword tag and frequency overrides, and location-based filtering.

The React 19 frontend uses a dark-themed UI (Tailwind CSS + Radix/Shadcn components) with real-time scan progress polling, animated summary stat cards, city-tab location filtering, a searchable keyword grid with trend sparklines, and Recharts-powered competitor visualizations. The admin panel provides multi-tab management for clients (branding, logo upload, webhook config), keywords (CRUD + bulk CSV), keyword discovery (scan + promote), and API usage monitoring with per-provider quota tracking and provider switching. Security includes Helmet headers, CORS origin restriction, express-rate-limit (300 req/min), Bearer token auth with timing-safe comparison on admin endpoints, parameterized SQL queries, and file upload validation (2MB, MIME whitelist). Deployment is a three-service Docker Compose stack (Node.js API, Nginx-served React build, optional SearXNG) with persistent volumes, health checks, Nginx reverse proxy with Let's Encrypt SSL, and an alternative PM2 bare-metal option.

projects.title: P3 Lite
projects.description: Fully automated SEO content publishing pipeline that generates ~1,200-word blog articles via AI (Claude or GPT), runs two-pass quality assurance with keyword density and banned-phrase enforcement, and publishes directly to client WordPress sites via REST API — replacing a 90-minute manual workflow with a 2-minute, $0.05-per-article automated process managed through a real-time web dashboard.
longDescription: Built a production-hardened content automation pipeline that takes article requests from queue to publish end-to-end. The two-pass AI architecture uses a creative generation pass (temperature 0.7) that produces full HTML articles with SEO titles, meta descriptions, URL slugs, FAQ schema, comparison tables, and how-to sections, followed by a precision QA pass (temperature 0.3) that enforces an 11-point checklist covering word count (1,100–1,300), keyword placement density, location mention frequency (8–12), banned AI-cliche phrases (28 blocked), and structured data completeness. The provider abstraction layer makes Claude Sonnet 4 and GPT-4o fully interchangeable with identical prompt pipelines and zero code changes.

The pipeline publishes to WordPress via REST API with full SEO metadata injection — RankMath and Yoast fields, Article + FAQPage JSON-LD schema markup, automatic category/tag resolution with auto-creation, and public URL rewriting for Docker-internal domains. Post-publish hooks request Google Search Console indexing, back up article HTML to date-partitioned directories, and enforce configurable daily spend caps with per-article token-level cost accounting. The atomic queue claim system uses OS-level file locking (flock) to prevent race conditions across the dual PM2 processes (API server + pipeline worker), with exponential backoff retry (up to 3 attempts) and Slack/Discord webhook alerting on failures.

The single-file HTML dashboard (no build step) provides multi-tab monitoring: article queue with status badges and pagination, published article history with cost tracking, failure alerts with one-click retry, searchable archive, and per-client management cards with connection testing. Security hardening includes session-based authentication with constant-time comparison, CSRF origin validation, Helmet security headers, rate limiting (10 login attempts/15min, 60 API calls/min), credential stripping from all API responses, HTTPS-enforced domain validation with SSRF protection, and a health endpoint exposing corruption detection, stuck-article monitoring, and provider configuration status. Deployment is a single docker-compose.yml with optional Nginx reverse proxy and Let's Encrypt SSL automation.

projects.title: ShortsEngine
projects.description: AI-powered YouTube Shorts automation platform that generates and uploads vertical video content at scale — combining multi-GPU inference (Ollama LLM, Stable Diffusion, Coqui TTS), trending topic discovery, video clipping automation with Whisper transcription and LLM highlight detection, and YouTube API integration for scheduled publishing and analytics.
longDescription: Built a full-stack content automation platform that generates YouTube Shorts from trending topics end-to-end — from news discovery and article scraping through AI script generation, image synthesis, text-to-speech with word-level timestamps, video assembly with animated captions, and automatic YouTube upload. The system runs on a 4x RTX 4090 server with GPU-specific Celery task queues: GPUs 0-2 for parallel Stable Diffusion image generation via ComfyUI WebSocket API, GPU 3 for Coqui XTTS-v2 voice cloning, and Ollama for script generation.

The video clipping pipeline automates repurposing of trending content from YouTube, Twitch, and Twitter — downloading videos via yt-dlp, transcribing with Whisper for word-level timestamps, detecting viral-worthy moments using LLM analysis with customizable prompts (e.g., rap battle punchlines, crowd reactions), extracting clips with FFmpeg, applying 9:16 vertical cropping, and queuing for approval or auto-upload. Each account can configure custom highlight detection prompts, clip duration constraints, crop modes, and auto-approval settings.

The platform supports multi-account management with per-account configuration for niche, prompt templates, visual styles, TTS voices, caption styles, scheduling intervals, and YouTube OAuth credentials. The React admin dashboard provides account management, content queue with preview and approval workflow, real-time generation progress tracking via Redis pub/sub, clipping source management, and YouTube analytics sync. Infrastructure includes PostgreSQL for persistence, Redis for Celery broker and progress tracking, MinIO for media storage, and Nginx reverse proxy with SSL.

projects.title: MODEXIS
projects.description: AI-powered content orchestration platform for SEO-driven web publishing at scale — combining LLM-based article generation, geographic/vertical directory graph targeting, multi-channel publishing (Astro SSR + WordPress), campaign lifecycle management with domain provisioning, and enterprise content governance through playbooks, QA agents, and policy enforcement.
longDescription: Built a full-stack content orchestration platform that automates the entire lifecycle of SEO-optimized web content — from topic research and outline generation through AI-powered article writing, quality assurance, deduplication, and multi-channel publishing. The system runs a local vLLM inference server (Llama-3.1-8B on dual GPUs) with micro-batching for throughput, orchestrated by Celery workers across specialized task queues for bulk dispatch, per-site generation, and publishing.

The platform models a directory graph of verticals (industries), geographic markets (state/city/neighborhood), page types (hub, money, supporting), and topic intents (informational, transactional, navigational) to produce targeted content at scale. Campaigns coordinate multi-site generation with automatic domain provisioning (DNS validation, Let's Encrypt SSL, Nginx config), while playbooks define reusable content workflows with routing rules, page matrix compilation, and validation gates. A policy system enforces content contracts including word count constraints, required sections (P3 template), deduplication thresholds, internal link mesh rules, source restrictions, and vertical-specific disclaimers.

The admin Control Center provides a 3-step article generation wizard, campaign management with lifecycle tracking and per-entry status monitoring, playbook configuration, job monitoring with real-time progress, and a knowledge base for content collections and entity management. The public-facing Astro SSR site dynamically resolves page specs via host-header routing for campaign domains, renders directory pages with JSON-LD schema markup, and generates per-domain XML sitemaps. Monitoring is handled through Prometheus metrics scraping and Grafana dashboards tracking LLM throughput, job status, and system health.

projects.title: CERBERUS AI
projects.description: Full-stack cybersecurity intelligence and AI-powered document analysis platform with multi-LLM integration, automated threat research pipelines, local file management with RAG-based Q&A, and scheduled email reporting.
longDescription: Built a comprehensive cybersecurity intelligence platform that combines AI-powered document processing, threat research, and investigation capabilities into a unified web application. The system integrates multiple LLM backends (Ollama, Google Gemini) via LangChain for flexible AI orchestration, supporting PDF analysis with OCR fallback, conversational chat, and structured incident investigations.

The research pipeline features an API-free discovery engine using RSS feeds, XML sitemaps, and polite domain crawling — with optional SearXNG, SERPAPI, and Tavily integration. Research jobs follow a draft-first workflow with multi-criteria scoring, AU-bias filtering, keyword pattern matching, and real-time progress streaming via Server-Sent Events. Completed research can be finalized into structured Markdown reports and delivered on schedule via configurable SMTP email automation.

A local storage module provides hierarchical file management supporting PDF, DOCX, CSV, XLSX, and MSG formats with batch OCR processing and multi-turn RAG-powered chat sessions over uploaded documents. The platform also includes ISO 27001 policy review with per-policy alignment scoring, an immutable cache management layer for discovery results, and full Docker Compose orchestration with PostgreSQL, SearXNG, Nginx reverse proxy, and health-checked services.

projects.title: WAREHOUSE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
projects.description: Full-stack multi-warehouse inventory and supply chain platform with mobile warehouse operations, barcode scanning, point-of-sale, and real-time stock tracking across warehouses and retail stores.
longDescription: Built a comprehensive Warehouse Management System that tracks inventory across the entire supply chain — from supplier goods receipt at warehouses, through internal transfers and deliveries, to retail store point-of-sale. The platform supports multi-warehouse and multi-store operations with role-based access control for admins, managers, warehouse staff, and viewers.

The system features a robust transaction workflow engine supporting four transaction types (Receive, Transfer, Deliver, Pull Out) each with strict status state machines. Delivery transactions follow an extended 8-stage workflow (draft → picking → DR generated → checking → packing → dispatched → received) with mobile pick/check operations using barcode scanning.

A companion mobile app built with Expo serves dual roles: warehouse staff use it for picking, checking, and dispatching deliveries with barcode scanning, while store staff use it as a full point-of-sale terminal with cart management, multiple payment methods, and receipt printing. Every action across the system is recorded in an immutable audit log with before/after JSON snapshots for complete traceability.
